sqlMap.select: SELECT BUYER , LEGACY_NO FROM IF_PROGRESS IF WHERE IF.BUYER = 'KRHUGE0001' AND IF.GUBUN = 'XX' AND IF.IF_FLAG = 'T' AND IF.REMARK = 'BUDGET'

SELECT PRDT.PR_NO AS ZMROPO , 'NB' AS BSART , '1000' AS BUKRS , '1000' AS EKORG , '800' AS EKGRP , ' ' AS LIFNR , 'KO' AS LANGU , 'KRW' WAERS , 1 WKURS , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS AEDAT , LUSR.LEGACY_USER_ID ERNAM , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS BEDAT FROM ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE PRDT.BUYER = #BUYER# AND PRDT.REF_NO = #LEGACY_NO# AND PRDT.BUYER = LUSR.COM_CODE AND PRDT.ADD_USER_ID = LUSR.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT substr(PR_SEQ,2,5) AS ZMRO_ITEMNO , BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR , REF_PR_NO AS WERKS , TARGET_QTY AS MENGE , UNIT_MEASURE AS MEINS , TARGET_PRICE AS NETPR , 1 AS PEINH , LUSR.LEGACY_USER_ID AS AFNAM , PRDT.ADD_USER_DEPT KOSTL FROM ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE PRDT.BUYER = #BUYER# AND PRDT.REF_NO = #LEGACY_NO# AND PRDT.BUYER = LUSR.COM_CODE AND PRDT.ADD_USER_ID = LUSR.USER_ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMPRDT SET LEGACY_PO_NO = #IT_POITEM.EBELN# , LEGACY_PO_SEQ = #IT_POITEM.EBELP# , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PR_NO = #ZMROPO# AND PR_SEQ = LPAD(#IT_POITEM.ZMRO_ITEMNO#,6,'0')
UPDATE ICOMPRDT SET LEGACY_PO_NO = 'D' , LEGACY_PO_SEQ = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE BUYER = 'KRHUGE0001' AND PR_NO = #ZMROPO#

UPDATE IF_PROGRESS SET CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS')
, IF_FLAG = 'C'
, IF_FLAG = 'E'
WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_NO = #LEGACY_NO# AND GUBUN = 'XX' AND IF_FLAG = 'T' AND REMARK = 'BUDGET'
sqlMap.select: SELECT A.TARGET AS BUYER ,B.LEGACY_PO_NO as EBELN ,B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ as EBELP ,CASE WHEN A.KEY_3 = 'DEL' THEN 'X' ELSE null END as LOEKZ ,A.KEY_4 as EX_MENGE ,A.KEY_5 as MENGE ,A.KEY_8 as ADD_DATE ,A.KEY_9 as IF_FLAG ,A.KEY_10 as IF_MSG ,B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR ,B.UNIT_MEASURE AS MEINS ,B.TARGET_PRICE AS NETPR ,1 AS PEINH ,B.ADD_USER_ID AS AFNAM ,B.PR_NO AS PR_NO ,B.PR_SEQ AS PR_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL A, ICOMPRDT B WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_CHG' AND A.KEY_1 = B.PR_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.PR_SEQ AND A.TARGET = 'KRHUGE0001' AND B.BUYER = 'KRHUGE0001' AND A.KEY_3 IN ('DEL','CHG') AND A.KEY_9 = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = #ZSTATUS# , KEY_10 = #ZMESSAGE# WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_CHG' AND KEY_1 = #IT_POITEM.PR_NO# AND KEY_2 = #IT_POITEM.PR_SEQ# AND TARGET = 'KRHUGE0001' AND KEY_3 IN ('DEL','CHG') AND KEY_9 = 'N'
